storyline.real: Alonso wins his home race from 5th on the grid on four stops; Räikkönen, on three, finishes second, 9.3 s behind. Massa is third.
storyline.headline: Alonso and Massa give Ferrari a one-two in Barcelona

mastery.label: Win on four stops (three more from here)

eras.briefing: Barcelona, 2013. The tyres wear fast. Alonso started 5th, has already stopped once and now leads. Räikkönen, fourth, will try to make one stop fewer work. You run Alonso. Win at home.
